name: todo
description: Keeps the native task list in front of the agent: the open tasks at session start and right after each compaction, a reminder that a new request becomes a task before any other work, and completed tasks moved to an archive log.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Show the open tasks and archive completed ones. Off, the mod does nothing.

remind.title: Request reminder
remind.description: With a named list (CLAUDE_CODE_TASK_LIST_ID), each prompt from the user carries a reminder: a new request becomes a task before any other work, with its owner in the subject.

archive.title: Archive completed tasks
archive.description: Move a completed task out of the list into ~/.local/state/mods/todo/<list>.jsonl, so the list holds only open work.
